{{Quote|Lando, let it go. Kessel is a doomed world.|Han Solo to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
A '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] took place in [[43 ABY]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] endeavored to save the world from destruction.

==Prelude==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] contacted ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] with news of sudden devastating quakes on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where he co-owned a profitable [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company, [[Calrissian-Nunb Mines]], with the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]]. The Solos agreed to travel to Kessel with their granddaughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], and the family's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to help Calrissian out. Upon their arrival on Kessel, they were briefed on the mines' history. The quakes had started around [[41 ABY]], during the height of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The Solos agreed to scout out the caves, and see if Leia's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|skills]] could figure out what the scientific teams Calrissian had sent down earlier could not.<ref name="Outcast" />

Journeying into dark caverns in an armed [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], the Solos were accidentally stranded in a deep gorge when their speeder crashed. Upon landing, they discovered several strange machines that were somehow connected to a large population of [[bogey]]s&mdash;creatures that disabled machinery if they came into contact. The machinery itself was emitting huge amounts of power, and would destroy the planet if left to function.<ref name="Outcast" />

==The mission==
Diagnosing the machinery as a threat, Calrissian called in several veteran [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Drathan Forge|Drathan]] and [[Inyri Forge]], [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], [[Koyi Komad]], [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], [[Kell Tainer]], [[Nrin Vakil]], and [[Rhysati Ynr]] to neutralize the installations. Equipped with various [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], including an [[Eta-5 interceptor|Eta-5 fighter]] and a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] along with several [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]], and led by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the team descended into the depths of the caves.<ref name="Outcast" />

Despite a close encounter with various strange lifeforms and some setbacks, the team was able to successfully find and disable all of the generators, thus saving Kessel and the Calrissian-Nunb Mines.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Aftermath==
Celebrations followed on the surface. Despite the success of the expedition, the true purpose of the strange machinery was never actually determined.<ref name="Outcast" />
